title: A creature standing between attacker and target gives no Half Cover: cover comes only from scene.cover/cover_all labels

history.reason: Under rule #5 and R-09, a creature in the line should also give +2 on Dexterity saves. Applying that breaks tests/scenarios/test_spells.py::test_spl05_burning_hands: G1 (5 ft) stands between MIALEE and G2 (10 ft), so G2's forced d20 of 9 becomes 9+2+2 = 13, meets DC 13, and G2 survives. A person should choose one: (a) change SPL-05 so G2's d20 still fails with the +2 (e.g. 8), or (b) rule that creatures in an area don't screen each other. Then drop creatures=False in spells.spell_save. Details are in loop/requests/T-16-creature-cover-saves.md.
